features.name: share_comments_identify_specific_problem
features.definition: What proportion of the counter-argument comments identify a specific problem in the OP's argument?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments). Use title and argument only to interpret what the OP argued. For each comment, decide whether the commenter's own assertion points out a specific, concrete problem in the OP's argument (e.g. a particular flawed premise, logical gap, factual error, counterexample or overlooked case, tied to something the OP said), rather than only vague disagreement, general opinion, off-topic remarks, or an unrelated alternative view. Problems merely stated in quotations attributed to others are not counted unless the commenter adopts them. Ignore any OP view-change/delta announcements, post-outcome updates or reports of outcome as evidence. Output = number of qualifying comments / total comments, in [0,1]. Empty list gives null; malformed input gives null. List order carries no meaning.

features.name: any_comment_identifies_specific_problem
features.definition: Does at least one counter-argument comment identify a specific problem in the OP's argument?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments. Use title and argument only to interpret the OP's claims. Return 1 if at least one comment, in the commenter's own assertion, points out a specific, concrete problem in the OP's argument (flawed premise, logical gap, factual error, counterexample, overlooked case tied to something the OP said); return 0 if none do (only vague disagreement, opinion, off-topic, or unadopted quotations). Ignore OP view-change/delta announcements, post-outcome updates and outcome reports as evidence. Empty list gives 0; malformed input gives null.

h0: share_comments_identify_specific_problem has no association with the probability the OP changed their view.
h1: Higher share_comments_identify_specific_problem is associated with a higher probability the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change), tested as an association only. Comments are unordered, with no per-comment outcomes, so the comment-level comparison (problem-identifying vs not) is aggregated to a row-level share; any-version is an alternate presence measure. Comment text may contain delta/outcome announcements, which the prompts exclude; reply timing is unknown. 'Specific' requires a judgment with no supplied scale.
